turns.text: Hi, this is the clinic's scheduling assistant. Would you like to book, reschedule or cancel an appointment?
I need to cancel my appointment for Friday.
Of course. Can I have your full name and the reason for the visit?
Maria Lopez. It was a check-up, but I just want to cancel it.
Thanks, Maria. I can offer Tuesday at 10 AM or Thursday at 2 PM. Which works for you?
No, I don't want a new time. I want to cancel.
I understand. The options I have are Tuesday at 10 AM or Thursday at 2 PM.
Forget it, I'll call the front desk.
